description.en:
Internal per-frame step of the camera-control helpers (CamCtrlInit, CamCtrlMoveTo, CamCtrlLookAtChara...). CallEvent calls it every frame with subev_ctx.cam_ctrl; events do not call it.
Without a camera it does nothing. With no move queued, it points the camera at its look-at point (following the character set by CamCtrlLookAtChara, if any) and marks the control finished.
Otherwise it advances the first queued move by the elapsed frames and interpolates: type 0 moves the position and look-at point in a straight line, type 1 turns around the look-at point by distance and angles. It then applies the engine camera move (CMND_GET_MOVE_INFO_CAMERA, then CMND_SET_CAMERA_POS and CMND_SET_CAMERA_REF). When the move's frames are over, the move is removed; once none are left, the control is marked finished (IsCamCtrlMove becomes false). It also calls CMND_CHECK_MOVE_CAMERA to wait for the engine move, but without the camera handle that command needs, so it always gets null and never delays the end.
